title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
abstract: arXiv:2609.37476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering

translated_title: 在策略状态空间中从互联网视频学习社交导航
translated_abstract: 训练鲁棒的社交导航策略需要具有多样化场景布局、地形和人体运动的模拟器，但构建此类环境并指定行人行为代价高昂。我们提出了一种高效的流水线，可将普通的单目行走视频直接转换为策略状态空间中的闭环社交导航训练环境。我们的关键观察是，局部社交导航主要依赖两类信息：机器人可以在哪里通行，以及附近行人如何移动。因此，我们将静态场景表示为度量可通行性地图，该地图可在反事实机器人运动下进行刚性变换，同时随时间直接回放从视频中恢复的行人轨迹。这种抽象使我们能够直接在策略的状态空间中定义前向动力学，并高效地模拟反事实机器人状态，而无需进行重建或渲染。
tldr: 提出一种将普通单目行走视频直接转化为策略状态空间中闭环社交导航训练环境的流水线，通过可通行性地图的刚性变换与行人轨迹回放来定义前向动力学，从而避免了昂贵的环境构建、重建与渲染。
en_tdlr: An efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy state space, defining forward dynamics via rigidly transformed traversability maps and replayed pedestrian trajectories without costly reconstruction or rendering.
